topics.title: Present Simple (I/you/we/they)
topics.explanation: We use the base verb with I, you, we, and they to talk about facts, habits, and things that are always true.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم الفعل الأساسي مع I وyou وwe وthey للحديث عن حقائق وعادات وأشياء صحيحة دائما.

examples.en: You live in a big town.
They go to school every day.

topics.title: Present Simple (he/she/it + -s)
topics.explanation: With he, she, and it, we add -s (or -es) to the end of the verb.
topics.explanationAr: مع he وshe وit، نضيف -s (أو -es) إلى نهاية الفعل.

examples.en: She goes to school by bus.
It rains a lot in winter.

topics.title: Present Simple Negatives
topics.explanation: We use "don't" (I/you/we/they) or "doesn't" (he/she/it) before the base verb to make a negative sentence.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "don't" (أنا/أنت/نحن/هم) أو "doesn't" (هو/هي) قبل الفعل الأساسي لصنع جملة منفية.

examples.en: We don't go there on Fridays.

topics.title: There is / There are
topics.explanation: We use "there is" for one thing, and "there are" for more than one thing.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "there is" لشيء واحد، و"there are" لأكثر من شيء واحد.

examples.en: There is a book on the table.
There are three cats in the garden.
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
Are there any pencils in your bag?
examples.ar: هل يوجد أقلام رصاص في حقيبتك؟

topics.title: This / That / These / Those
topics.explanation: "This" and "these" point to things near us. "That" and "those" point to things far away. "This/that" are singular; "these/those" are plural.
topics.explanationAr: "This" و"these" للإشارة إلى أشياء قريبة. "That" و"those" للإشارة إلى أشياء بعيدة. "this/that" للمفرد، و"these/those" للجمع.

examples.en: That is your bag, over there.

topics.title: Plural Nouns
topics.explanation: Most nouns add -s to become plural. Nouns ending in s/sh/ch/x add -es. Some nouns are irregular.
topics.explanationAr: معظم الأسماء تضيف -s لتصبح جمعا. الأسماء المنتهية بـ s/sh/ch/x تضيف -es. بعض الأسماء شاذة.

topics.title: Possessive Adjectives
topics.explanation: My, your, his, her, its, our, and their go before a noun to show who it belongs to.
topics.explanationAr: my وyour وhis وher وits وour وtheir تأتي قبل الاسم لتوضح ملكيته.

topics.title: Prepositions of Place
topics.explanation: Words like next to, between, behind, in front of, above, and below tell us where something is.
topics.explanationAr: كلمات مثل next to وbetween وbehind وin front of وabove وbelow تخبرنا بمكان شيء ما.

examples.en: The cat is next to the box.
The ball is between the chairs.
The dog is behind the door.
The lamp is above the table.

topics.title: Can / Can't (Ability)
topics.explanation: We use "can" to say what someone is able to do, and "can't" for what they are not able to do.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "can" لقول ما يستطيع شخص فعله، و"can't" لما لا يستطيع فعله.

topics.title: Wh- Questions
topics.explanation: Who, what, where, when, why, and how start questions that ask for specific information, not just yes/no.
topics.explanationAr: who وwhat وwhere وwhen وwhy وhow تبدأ أسئلة تطلب معلومة محددة، وليس فقط نعم/لا.

topics.title: Comparatives (bigger, smaller)
topics.explanation: We add -er to short adjectives (or use "more" with longer ones) to compare two things.
topics.explanationAr: نضيف -er للصفات القصيرة (أو نستخدم "more" مع الأطول) لمقارنة شيئين.

examples.en: The elephant is bigger than the fox.
This box is smaller than that one.
She is taller than her brother.
My bag is heavier than yours.

topics.title: Articles: a / an / the
topics.explanation: We use "a" before consonant sounds and "an" before vowel sounds for one unspecified thing. We use "the" for something specific.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "a" قبل الأصوات الساكنة و"an" قبل الأصوات الصوتية لشيء غير محدد. نستخدم "the" لشيء محدد.

topics.title: Imperatives (Commands)
topics.explanation: We use the base verb alone to give commands or instructions, without a subject.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم الفعل الأساسي وحده لإعطاء أوامر أو تعليمات، دون ذكر الفاعل.

topics.title: Present Continuous (I am doing)
topics.explanation: We use "am/is/are + verb-ing" for actions happening right now -- this is different from Present Simple, which is for habits and facts.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "am/is/are + الفعل مع ing" لأفعال تحدث الآن -- وهذا مختلف عن المضارع البسيط المستخدم للعادات والحقائق.

examples.en: She is reading a book right now.
They are running in the park.
